jobs.title: Environmental Scientists, Engineers, Geologists, and Business Support Professionals - All Levels
jobs.description:
Company Description

Elkhorn Environmental Solutions, Inc. (Elkhorn) is a California-based environmental consulting firm providing strategic, technically sound solutions for environmental due diligence, site investigation, remediation, redevelopment, and regulatory closure. Our multidisciplinary team brings expertise in environmental engineering, geology, toxicology, risk assessment, and applied environmental science to help clients navigate complex environmental challenges and move projects forward.
We partner with property owners, developers, attorneys, lenders, businesses, regulatory agencies, and multidisciplinary project teams to develop practical strategies tailored to project goals, regulatory requirements, and site-specific conditions. Our work includes environmental due diligence and liability evaluation; soil, soil vapor, and groundwater investigation; vapor intrusion assessment; remediation design and optimization; redevelopment support; environmental risk assessment; and regulatory closure.

At Elkhorn, our focus extends beyond identifying environmental challenges, we develop clear, defensible pathways for addressing them. We deliver practical, technically sound strategies that help clients manage risk, navigate regulatory requirements, and move sites toward successful redevelopment and closure.

Role Description

This is a full-time opportunity based Northern California, with positions available in the San Francisco Bay Area, Sacramento Region, and Sierra Foothills for Environmental Scientists, Engineers, Geologists, and Business Support Professionals at all experience levels
. Technical professionals will support projects involving site assessments, soil, soil vapor, and groundwater investigations, remediation planning and implementation, and environmental due diligence. Day-to-day responsibilities may include conducting field work, collecting and managing environmental data, preparing technical reports and figures, supporting conceptual site model development and risk evaluations, and coordinating with clients, regulators, and project partners.
Business support professionals will support the administrative, accounting, financial, and operational functions of the firm. Responsibilities may include project administration, proposal and contract support, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing and billing support, expense tracking, financial recordkeeping, project accounting, data management, scheduling, and other administrative and operational activities that help keep our projects and business running efficiently.
Responsibilities will vary based on each team member’s experience, background, and area of expertise.

Qualifications

Relevant education, training, or professional experience appropriate to the position and level of responsibility.
For technical roles, a degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, toxicology, or a related discipline is preferred.
Experience with environmental consulting, field investigations, regulatory programs, technical reporting, project coordination, or environmental data management is beneficial for technical positions.
For business support roles, experience or education in accounting, finance, business administration, project administration, or a related field is valued.
Experience with accounts payable/receivable, invoicing, billing, project accounting, financial recordkeeping, or general administrative support is beneficial for accounting and business support positions.
Experience using BQE CORE for project accounting, billing, time and expense management, or related business operations is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, analytical, communication, writing, and documentation skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
Familiarity with common office, accounting, project management, GIS, data analysis, or other technical software applicable to the position is advantageous.
Experience in environmental consulting or professional services is a plus but is not required for all positions.

We welcome candidates at all experience levels who are interested in growing with a collaborative environmental consulting firm.

jobs.title: Environmental Health Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist

📍 Hayward, CA | Full-Time, On-Site
💰 $95,000–$120,000 annually, depending on experience

Position Summary

Our client is seeking an experienced Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist
to support and lead EHS programs at its Hayward manufacturing facility. This is a hands-on role focused on workplace safety, regulatory compliance, hazard reduction, employee training, and promoting a strong safety culture.
The EHS Specialist will work closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Engineering, Quality, HR, and leadership to ensure compliance with federal, state, and local environmental and workplace safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain EHS policies, procedures, and programs.
Ensure compliance with OSHA/Cal/OSHA, EPA
, and applicable environmental and safety regulations.
Conduct facility inspections, safety audits, hazard assessments, and job safety analyses.
Manage safety programs including PPE, HazCom, chemical safety, LOTO, ergonomics, emergency preparedness, and injury prevention
.
Maintain SDS documentation and chemical inventories and support proper chemical handling, storage, labeling, and disposal.
Coordinate hazardous waste and environmental compliance activities.
Conduct employee EHS training, including new-hire orientation and refresher training.
Investigate incidents, injuries, and near misses; perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
Maintain OSHA logs, training records, inspection documentation, and other required EHS records.
Support emergency response planning, evacuation procedures, and drills.
Partner with Operations and Engineering to identify hazards associated with equipment, processes, chemicals, and facility changes.
Serve as a point of contact for EHS-related inspections and regulatory inquiries.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Health & Safety, Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, or related field preferred.
3+ years of EHS experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.

Working knowledge of OSHA/Cal/OSHA
and environmental regulations.
Experience with hazardous materials, chemical safety, hazardous waste, and SDS management.
Experience conducting safety audits, risk assessments, incident investigations, and root cause analysis.
Knowledge of LOTO, PPE, HazCom, emergency response, and injury prevention programs.
Strong communication, training, documentation, and organizational skills.
Comfortable working hands-on within a manufacturing environment.

Preferred

Experience in semiconductor, high-purity manufacturing, medical device, chemical processing, or another regulated manufacturing environment
.
Experience working around cleanrooms, chemicals, gases, vacuum systems, or specialized manufacturing processes.
Familiarity with ISO 14001 and/or ISO 45001
.
OSHA 30, CSP, ASP, CHMM, or similar certification.
Experience interacting with Cal/OSHA or other regulatory agencies
